description: Discover valid values for ClinicalTrials.gov fields with study counts per value. Use to explore available filter options before building a search — e.g., valid OverallStatus, Phase, InterventionType, StudyType, or LeadSponsorClass values.

anyOf.description: Multiple PascalCase field names (at least one required).

fields.description: PascalCase field name(s) to get value statistics for — an empty list is rejected, not treated as "every field". Examples: OverallStatus, Phase, StudyType, Sex, LeadSponsorClass. Use clinicaltrials_get_field_definitions with a query to find more field names.

name: clinicaltrials_get_field_values

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `blank_value`: A parameter was supplied with a blank, whitespace-only, or empty-list value. `field_invalid`: A requested field name is not a valid PascalCase piece name. `rate_limited`: ClinicalTrials.gov returned 429 after retry budget exhausted. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fieldStats.description: One entry per requested field: canonical path, PascalCase piece name, data type, and the statistics variant that type carries — top values with study counts plus unique/longest for ENUM/STRING, trueCount/falseCount for BOOLEAN, min/max/avg for INTEGER/NUMBER, min/max/formats for DATE.

items.description: Statistics for a single requested field.

avg.description: Mean of the recorded values. Present for INTEGER/NUMBER fields.

falseCount.description: Studies where field is false. Present for BOOLEAN fields.

formats.description: Date patterns this field is recorded in. Present for DATE fields; more than one means the field mixes precisions across studies.

longest.description: Longest recorded value with its length and a study carrying it. Present for STRING fields only.

nctId.description: NCT ID of a study carrying it.

anyOf.description: Largest value of an INTEGER/NUMBER field.
Latest value of a DATE field, at the precision recorded.

max.description: Largest recorded value — a number for INTEGER/NUMBER, a date string for DATE.

anyOf.description: Smallest value of an INTEGER/NUMBER field.
Earliest value of a DATE field, at the precision recorded — a partial date such as "1900-01" stays partial.

min.description: Smallest recorded value — a number for INTEGER/NUMBER, a date string for DATE.

missingStudiesCount.description: Number of studies where this field is absent.

multiValued.description: True when the field is repeated — array-typed itself (Phase, Condition) or nested under a repeated object (LocationCountry, one per site) — so a study can carry several values and the per-value studiesCount buckets sum above the study total. Use to avoid computing a percentage against the corpus.

topValues.description: Values ranked by frequency (capped at 250 by the API). Present for ENUM/STRING fields. When multiValued is true, studiesCount sums can exceed the study total.

items.description: A value and its study count.

studiesCount.description: Number of studies with this value.

trueCount.description: Studies where field is true. Present for BOOLEAN fields.

type.description: Field data type (ENUM, BOOLEAN, STRING, DATE, etc.).

title: Clinicaltrials Get Field Values
